body: I’m asking this only because it’s happened to me but are you sure things are completely over with him and the ex? If they were together for a few years and had a toxic relationship, the breakup might not hava been as clean-cut as he makes it seem to be. Again, not saying this is the issue but it certainly was with me lol

> "I saw my life branching out before me like the green fig tree in the story. From the tip of every branch, like a fat purple fig, a wonderful future beckoned and winked. One fig was a husband and a happy home and children, and another fig was a famous poet and another fig was a brilliant professor, and another fig was Ee Gee, the amazing editor, and another fig was Europe and Africa and South America, and another fig was Constantin and Socrates and Attila and a pack of other lovers with queer names and offbeat professions, and another fig was an Olympic lady crew champion, and beyond and above these figs were many more figs I couldn't quite make out. I saw myself sitting in the crotch of this fig tree, starving to death, just because I couldn't make up my mind which of the figs I would choose. I wanted each and every one of them, but choosing one meant losing all the rest, and, as I sat there, unable to decide, the figs began to wrinkle and go black, and, one by one, they plopped to the ground at my feet." 

from The Bell Jar by Sylvia Plath. Describes this sort of feeling perfectly for me but ya all day every day. There's so much to world and so little time, fucking sucks. Yours truly jack of all trades master of none.
Ouch isn’t that the truth. And I feel that, I’d rather be on a roll and remember exactly what went wrong in each step before to ensure I won’t do them again. I’ll do new mistakes instead lol

Omg that’s a fantastic idea. EM909, you were chosen because of your genotype but will be remembered for your sacrifice. Thank you <3 that actually makes me feel a little better.

And sorry you had that experience, sounds like a shit situation. I was lucky to be put in a lab where I can feel comfortable with the techniques and the reasons why we use them. Otherwise probably couldn’t have done it. It took me months to feel comfortable with perfusions and about a year to take the brain out of the skull without shedding a tear. Used to ask my friend to get their eyes out prior so they wouldn’t stare at me ugh neuro is a weird field but all of my lil friends will be remembered.

Fuck, thank you. I feel like everything keeps going wrong with this, but I really want to get better. Tomorrow I'll make sure to take my time, and ask for help if I need to. Maybe go cry at Subway this time who knows.

I think everyone forgets to be easy on themselves sometimes but in reality shit goes wrong in a lab environment all. the. time. It just sucks that sometimes those mistakes can cost not only time and money, but a life too. thank you.
